enabled.title: Turn on Creator Controls
enabled.description: When enabled, the three Apply Profile actions can request your saved channel setup.

allowSimulatedControls.title: Allow Streamer.bot Test buttons
allowSimulatedControls.description: Turn this on only while testing. Turn it back off before a live stream.

profile1Enabled.title: Use this profile
profile1Enabled.description: Makes Profile 1 available to its Streamer.bot action.

profile1Name.title: Profile name
profile1Name.description: A private label that helps you remember when to use it.

profile1Platforms.title: Update these platforms
profile1Platforms.description: Only checked platforms are changed when this profile runs.

profile1Title.title: Stream title
profile1Title.description: The title sent to every checked platform.

profile1TwitchCategoryId.title: Twitch category ID
profile1TwitchCategoryId.description: Optional numeric Twitch game/category ID. Leave blank to keep the current category.

profile1YoutubeCategoryName.title: YouTube category
profile1YoutubeCategoryName.description: Optional category name. Leave blank to keep the current category.

profile1YoutubeBroadcastId.title: YouTube broadcast ID (advanced)
profile1YoutubeBroadcastId.description: Usually leave blank to use the latest monitored broadcast.

profile1KickCategoryName.title: Kick category
profile1KickCategoryName.description: Optional category name. Leave blank to keep the current category.
